Recommend **one intervention: add a live-gallery nearest-positive/nearest-negative margin term to the existing SmoothAP objective**, using identical full-feature readouts in both arms. This changes supervision of the first retrieval hit while adding no serving operation.

The measured evidence supports testing this mechanism, without establishing it as the cause. The [terminal receipt](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/docs/evidence/compact_metric/sop-siglip2-substrate-v1/fullfeature-residual-full-selection-score-v1/receipt.json) records mean gains of +0.002018454 R1 and +0.009713700 AP, passing training-cost ratios, but one lost recall query at seed069. The frozen verdict remains **KILL**, with zero bootstrap draws and no validation admission. Its fixed TRAIN diagnostic also reported no demonstrated mechanism.

The earlier nearest-positive hinge improved recall but reduced AP; it used a frozen teacher gallery and only trainable `A`. The [current loss](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_compact_ranking.py:866) averages SmoothAP across every eligible positive and differentiates through the current gallery. My inference is that explicitly supervising the best-positive versus best-impostor boundary could improve recall while retaining SmoothAP’s ranking-depth supervision. That inference needs the paired utility test below.

1. **Freeze one fresh paired recipe.** Both arms start from authenticated accepted concat `A0=b702e038…`, with `C=0`; neither initializes from a terminal continuation. Both train exactly `[A,C]`, shaped `[128,160]` and `[128,1152]`. Retain the original concat helper exactly once, canonical TRAIN mean, frozen encoder/head/classifier/means, both genuine cached views, TRAIN6355/1008 identities, twelve singletons, and first128 B64 schedules for seeds179061/179069.

   Preserve FP32 arithmetic, micro16 accumulation, AdamW lr`1e-4`, decay`.05`, original defaults, scaler128, and one global clip1 over `[A,C]`. This fresh control reproduces the former full-feature candidate objective; the experimental difference is solely the additional margin term.

2. **Define the candidate term precisely.** Control minimizes existing prototype regression plus unchanged connected-gallery SmoothAP, temperature`.01`, coefficient1. Candidate additionally minimizes coefficient1 times

   `H = Σ relu(.05 + s_negative − s_positive) / (.05 · 2K)`.

   Use the existing live anchor-to-canonical-gallery score matrix. For each valid anchor, choose the highest-scoring other original image of its identity and highest-scoring wrong-identity image. Exact ties choose ascending original-row ID, matching [select_nearest](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_nearest_ranking.py:624). Detach scores only for choosing indices; gather the selected values from the connected scores so both query and gallery roles receive gradients.

   `K` is the full B64 valid-positive count, shared across both views and every microbatch. Filter invalid positives before indexing. Singletons receive regression only. Keep all original SmoothAP positives and negatives. No temperature, margin, coefficient, sampling, or schedule search.

3. **Reuse the actual source; change its explicit assumptions.** Modify only the current trainer/test and evaluator/test closures. Reuse cache admission, teachers`T/P/e0`, schedules, `ranking_membership`, `ranking_gallery`, SmoothAP arithmetic, complete replay/restoration, native authority, portable bundles, and source-byte checks.

   The present arm dispatch makes control `C` frozen and bypasses its forward operation. Replace those assumptions under **new procedure schemas**: both experimental arms have trainable, serialized full-feature `C` and the same inference computation; objective arm determines only whether `H` enters backward. Update optimizer membership, role fingerprints, nonzero-C inference witnesses, and evaluator bindings accordingly. Preserve every old schema, receipt, and verdict. Do not import the old frozen-teacher hinge loss unchanged.

4. **Use one fast falsifier before training.** Within the single CPU qualification, evaluate each seed’s fixed first B64 at `A0,C0`. Require matched raw/unit/packed outputs and control correspondence to the authenticated old full-feature objective. Independently verify nearest indices, self exclusion, ties, singleton/all-invalid behavior, and full64 versus micro16 reductions.

   Require an active hinge and finite nonzero auxiliary gradients; independently split query/gallery parameter copies and verify tied gradients equal their sum for both `A` and `C`. Candidate-minus-control preclip gradients must equal the auxiliary contribution. Reject detached-gallery and wrong-positive mutants. **Any failure kills this fixed recipe**, without finding another batch or adjusting constants. These are admission checks; the quality screen supplies the scientific falsifier.

5. **Bound execution and preserve the decisive gates.** Root alone owns execution. Retain CPU500s; sequential discarded mechanics600s each, uninterrupted17 versus independent8+9 and strict reload; fresh TRAIN128/600s; evaluator CPU500s, independent two-pass B32 exports900s, score500s. Require host≤8GiB, swap/events0, CUDA allocation<10GB, both lifetime locks, and one original job at a time. Charge mining, gallery reconstruction/backward, transfers, and auxiliary backward to core. Fresh whole/core candidate-control ratios must each be≤1.50.

   Run control061 then candidate061. Complete endpoint/resource/cost admission precedes the observed selection1734q/1715g/498 read. **Immediate KILL** if candidate R1≤control, AP<control, source floors fail, R1≤`.9648212226066898`, or AP<`.8177754035543956`. Only CONTINUE admits candidate069 then control069.

   The **single decisive full GO test** retains both per-seed positive-R1/nonnegative-AP requirements, equal-seed gains≥`.002` for both metrics, and both paired-product95% lower bounds>0 using shared5000 draws/seed179019, with query intervals reported. Failed per-seed gates stop before bootstrap. No gate relaxation or extra TRAIN budget.

6. **Advance a survivor directly to confirmation and serving.** Preserve accepted concat, hinge R1 Pareto, and both full-feature endpoints as development candidates, without using them to rescue this verdict. A new full selection GO admits the unchanged sealed validation1749q/1730g panel once. A confirmation failure closes the intervention.

   After confirmation, root freezes production training and complete checkpoints before official evaluation, carries the fixed intervention through the SOP comparison, and requires **both official protocol-comparable quality results**. Qualify updated portable packed128 serving and measure matched public B1/B32 image-to-top-k latency, tails, and throughput. The added training term disappears at inference, but current public latency remains unmeasured; training and export timings cannot establish a speed win.

The unchanged AP, seed, confirmation, official-quality, and serving gates make each risk actionable. No files were edited or jobs launched.
